focus: D4 Maintainability - entrypoint map, retained identifiers, database-dir alias defect, and the retired stress suite

findingDetails.title: Bin entrypoint map describes a dual-stack MCP surface and prints a CLI dist path that does not exist
findingDetails.evidence: :21 states the CLI shims run against 'the same unchanged daemons the MCP registrations use, a dual-stack surface, not a replacement' and names skill-advisor; :64 and :99 call the launcher an MCP launcher/child; :100 prints mcp-server/dist/mcp-server/skill-advisor-cli.js; :153 says the launcher starts the MCP server. The shim resolves runtime/dist/runtime/skill-advisor-cli.js (skill-advisor.cjs:22-23).
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite the advisor rows and the dual-stack sentence to the single-front-door model and correct the printed dist path.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the shim's constants and listed the built CLI file to bound the defect to the document; checked the file against phase 007's exemption list (absent) and its sweep scope.

findingDetails.title: Advisor database-directory legacy fallback is a self-fallback and its README documents the alias as working
findingDetails.evidence: process.env.SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DB_DIR ?? process.env.SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_DB_DIR in three load sites (skill-advisor-cli.ts:199, lib/skill-graph/skill-graph-db.ts:271, lib/scorer/projection.ts:58); runtime/database/README.md:25 claims a legacy fallback remains and renders both names identically.
findingDetails.recommendation: Restore the distinct legacy variable name in all three operands or delete the dead fallback and the README sentence.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Provenance checked at ed5f102287 (last pre-decommission commit): identical operand pair and identical README sentence, so this is pre-existing and excluded from any regression claim.

findingDetails.title: Stress suite still carries the retired transport in its name and runs in no default suite
findingDetails.evidence: Module header reads 'sa-027 / sa-028 — MCP Diagnostics Stress Test' while its fixtures use runtime/database/ paths; vitest.config.ts:21 includes only tests/**/*.vitest.ts, so the suite is outside every default run.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rename the suite to the daemon-diagnostics contract it actually asserts, and either promote it into the default suite or record why it stays outside.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the suite's module header, its DB path constant and the vitest include/exclude globs; confirmed the exclusion is by directory scope rather than by an explicit skip.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Maintainability pass over the entrypoint map and retained identifiers, with one pre-existing correctness defect surfaced.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The bin folder is the only operator map of the repo entrypoints, and the retired-coverage question needs the suite inventory rather than a document claim.
